verdict.rationale: IP India is an online e-filing and search service, so offering an API, CLI or other headless automation interface is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only web-portal features (e-filing, public status search, journals, cause lists), and the probe found no agent-oriented docs index (llms.txt 404). Nothing documents headless or CI-runnable operation, so the verdict is none.
